title: Minimum on-site car parking spaces, Perth and Peel (Table 2.3a)
text: Applies to development within the Perth and Peel regions only. C2.3.1 Car parking is provided on site in accordance with Table 2.3a.

replaces.note: R40 and below: Location A 1-2 bed 1 -> 0; Location B 2+ bed 2 -> 1

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Minimum applies to all parking on site (garages, carports, uncovered, undercroft, basement). Location A/B definitions are in the table notes (register ch2-023: straight-line measurement enlarges Location A). Ancillary dwelling row and the R50+ maximum column are separate rules (C2.3.1-r1, -r2, -r3).
